does: Gives the FixedString value of one fixed property of a spell prototype, used as the default text key for its conditions.

evidence.says: reads a FixedString property through eoc::SpellPrototype::GetFixedStringValue; eoc::SpellPrototype::GetRollSpellConditionsPerTextKey passes its result as the key of the first condition

questions.ask: which property it reads (the global at 0x145FC1CE0 names it); a probe on it with a snapshot of its result while a spell is aimed, compared with the FixedString of Default
